args.command:
cd /tau/self; node - <<'EOF'
import { run, values } from '@api/tau'

const { word, report } = values() as { word: string; report: { $out: string } }
console.log(JSON.stringify(await run('/tau/self/taus/shout', { text: word, out: report })))
EOF
args.description: Run the shout TAU on the word
